test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

Existentialism has a reputation for being angst-ridden and gloomy mostly because of its emphasis on pondering the meaningless of existence.

options.text: on pondering the meaningless of existence

solution:
The erroneous sentence is: **on pondering the meaningless of existence**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the word 'meaningless' is incorrect and should be replaced with 'meaninglessness'.
 
• The correct form should be *pondering the meaninglessness of existence*.
 
• The presence of article **'the'** before **'meaningless' **hints at the fact that the **word **must be replaced by a **noun (meaninglessness) **as **'meaningless' **is an **adjective**.
 
• This is because** 'meaninglessness'** is the noun form that correctly fits the context of the sentence.

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Correct sentence: *Existentialism has a reputation for being angst-ridden and gloomy mostly because of its emphasis on pondering the **meaninglessness **of existence*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word **'meaningless'** is an **adjective**, and in the given context, a noun form is required.
 
• Adjectives describe nouns, but in this case, we need a noun to describe the state of having no meaning.
 
• Therefore, 'meaninglessness' is the correct noun form to use in this context.
